excerpt: Linde (NYSE:LIN; FWB:LIN) announced today that it has entered into a long-term agreement with Samsung Electronics to supply ultra-high purity industrial gases for its latest semiconductor facilities in Pyeongtaek, South Korea.
notes: Press release says Samsung Electronics and the Pyeongtaek semiconductor complex (memory and foundry lines); unit not specified, samsung-memory chosen as most plausible. Release also says Linde is already the main supplier at existing Pyeongtaek facilities.
